## Summary

Internship project on process automation design and predictive maintenance for ThaiBev fermentation systems. The work was presented internally as *Integrated Industrial Process Automation, Computational Simulation, and Sustainable Energy Management: A Case Study from ThaiBev* (July 2024).

## Scope of work

- Variable-speed-drive (VSD) control for agitator motors in fermentation.
- Cooling-system automation for fermentation, with PLC–SCADA integration for real-time monitoring and control.
- Electrical system design and energy-management support, including stability analysis of a hybrid solar–gas engine power plant.
- Calibration of pressure and temperature instruments (including RTD PT100 sensors) with precision reference instruments, following ISO/IEC 17025 practice.
- CFD and biogas-mixing simulations of fermentation-tank airflow and temperature distribution.
- A recurrent neural network (RNN) model for predictive maintenance trained on one year of SCADA data.

The detailed internal report is confidential to ThaiBev.
